name: vfl-m3-split-mlp

fusion.input: [f_A(x_A), h_1, h_2, h_3]; a zero-filled or masked slot is 0

architecture.loss: softmax cross-entropy, mean over the batch
architecture.init: W ~ N(0, 1/in) from splitmix64(initSeed + member tag: fA 0, fusion 100, f_i i), b = 0
architecture.embeddingGradient: straight-through: a passive backpropagates A's gradient as if clipping and noise were the identity

fixedPoint.rounding: round to nearest, then clip to the integer range

scoring: retrain the fusion model only (bottom models frozen), from its initial weights, T epochs over I^tr with the same optimiser, learning rate, batch size and batch order
